note: Numerical settings for the classical reference only. Physical values come from physical-case-pending.json and are never changed here. Spec: docs/reference-solver/SPEC_reference_solutions.md.
agreement_note: Two solutions agree when every wall value differs by at most 1e-4 relative, about 4 significant figures (SPEC V4 to V8).
branch_scan_note: Smooth decaying guesses that satisfy B1, B2, B3, B5 and B6 at eta=0. Every converged solution is kept and grouped into branches by its wall values.
L_reference_note: Our choice; kept by the user on 2026-11-26 (docs/plans/L_STUDY.md). From L = 20 to 40 the wall values of f, g and theta change by at most 7e-5 relative, phi(0) by 3.9e-4 (reference/study.json, check V5, which therefore fails its 1e-4 bar). Distance of the L = 20 values from the eta -> infinity limit: 1.6e-4 to 3.3e-4 relative, phi(0) 1.8e-3 (reference/l_choice.md). PINN and reference both solve the L = 20 problem, so this L error is reported beside the PINN error, not inside it. chi has no L-independent limit, so chi is defined by chi(L)=0 at this L. Corrected 2026-11-26: the earlier note said every f, g, theta, phi wall value agreed with the next L to 1e-4.
far_field_note: theta(inf)=0 and phi(inf)=0 are imposed at eta=L as asymptotic conditions (Lentini and Keller 1980, doi:10.1137/0717049), derived in equations.far_conditions. f1, f2, g keep zero values at L (they decay exponentially). chi keeps chi(L)=0 because Eq. 18 as printed has no decaying far-field solution for chi. Set to 'dirichlet' for the old truncation.
rk_note: Second, independent reference (check V10): multiple shooting with SciPy's DOP853 Runge-Kutta on 40 wall-clustered segments, Newton on the joins and boundary conditions, started from the smooth guess only. rtol_check is a looser second solve that estimates the integrator's own error.
fixed_problem_note: Every solve uses Eqs. 14 to 18, B1 to B12 and the 22 locked supervisor values. There is no continuation through other parameter values, no check at other values and no forced equation (removed 2026-11-24): if a solve fails, the answer is more starting guesses or a longer L, never another value (AGENTS.md section 3).
